summary.name: Windscribe
summary.one_liner: Windscribe is a VPN and proxy service with ad blocking, open-source components, and servers in over 130 locations.
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Windscribe as a VPN and proxy service that aims to protect online privacy and mask location. It says the project is open source and publishes transparency reports and audits. It states that its RAM disk infrastructure stores no identifying data. It mentions AES256 encryption and a "No Logs" policy. The page also says billing is fixed at the price the user signed up for, and lists 4.7 stars from 13K reviews on app stores. Ad blocking and flexible server switching are mentioned via the directory listing, not in detail on the page.
notable: Open source, with published transparency reports and audits (per page)
RAM disk infrastructure that stores no identifying data (per page)
Fixed-price billing claim: price signed up for is price paid
caveats: Page does not clearly state free-tier limits or paid plan prices
Directory listing marks it as freeware, while page text is mostly marketing claims
